question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**frequently**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage is comparing the vulnerability of forests in the Western and Eastern Himalayas to forest fires.
 
• The appropriate **adverb **should describe the degree of vulnerability in a **comparative** manner.
 
• "**Frequently**" fits well because it emphasizes how often forest fires might occur in the Western Himalayas compared to the Eastern Himalayas, consistent with the comparative nature of the passa
